How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. with a B.Tech./M.Tech equivalent in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. Additionally, at least 3 publications in Scopus-indexed journals and experience with Ansys Fluent and OpenFOAM are necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow position ranges from Rs. 75,400 to Rs. 79,300 per month, which includes HRA. The exact salary depends on the candidate's post-doctoral experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google Forms link before the last date. You can find the link in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility, academic record, and relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview via email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q9. Who can I contact for more details about the position?
faq.answer: For more details, you can contact Prof. Raja Banerjee at [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for details related to this recruitment is https://cleanz.coe.iith.ac.in/index.html.
